extraction.document_summary: FWD Recover First is a critical illness insurance policy that combines multiple claim types rather than paying only from a fixed list once. The base component provides coverage for “37 late-stage critical illnesses” and pays 100% of the chosen sum insured “in one lump sum”; however, your policy “will be terminated once this base benefit is fully paid out.” A separate “Future Protect Benefit” supports early and intermediate critical illness (including impairment, surgery or ICU stay with invasive life support for at least 5 days) and provides a “Multiple payout via Reset Benefit” where the base sum insured resets 12 months after diagnosis, with future premiums waived upon a valid Future Protect claim. It also includes a “Special Benefit” paying S$25,000 per diagnosis for up to 6 claims (up to 10 named conditions), but it ends if you make a Future Protect claim. For certain critical illnesses, a 90-day waiting period from issuance/reinstatement applies; and exclusions include suicide/self-inflicted acts within one year and unlawful acts.
quality_notes: Brochure provides clear benefit names and key numbers (S$25,000 Special Benefit, 37 late-stage illnesses, S$5,000 Death Benefit, sum insured ranges, S$10,000 recovery programme value).

Some structural details (e.g., whether Future Protect Benefit and Recover First Benefit are strictly “base” vs rider components) are described in terms of “base benefit” and “rider” language is not consistently used; extracted fields are limited to what is explicitly stated.

policies.quick_summary: Critical illness policy with multiple claim mechanics: 37 late-stage illnesses (100% lump sum of chosen sum insured; termination once fully paid), Future Protect Benefit for early/intermediate impairment/surgery/ICU with invasive life support (5+ days) with a Reset Benefit after 12 months and waiver of future premiums upon a successful Future Protect claim, and a Special Benefit that pays S$25,000 per diagnosis for up to 6 Special Benefit conditions but ends once a Future Protect claim is made. Includes a S$5,000 Death Benefit and Recovery Programme services worth up to S$10,000. Applies a 90-day waiting period for specified critical illnesses.

evidence.quote: Multiple payout via Reset Benefit*
We have designed the product to continue covering you against late stage critical illnesses at 100% of your chosen sum insured, even after the first successful claim on Future Protect Benefit.
The full sum insured will reset 12 months from the date of diagnosis.

*For a period of 12 months beginning from the diagnosis date of the Future Protect Benefit claim, the sum insured for the base benefit will be reduced to zero. This 12-month period is called the “Reset Period”. During the Reset Period, you cannot make any claims on the base benefit.

*The Recover First Benefit (base benefit) sum insured will be reset to the original amount (less any angioplasty & other invasive treatments for coronary artery claim paid) if there is no other claim made (aside from an angioplasty & other invasive treatment for coronary artery claim) during the Reset Period.
